**Use one viewport-level Lenis instance, driven by GSAP’s ticker, and choose Roboto Serif for the display type.** Its real width axis makes a narrow editorial setting feasible; Bodoni Moda does not offer that adjustment. [web:13][web:90][web:58]

| Topic | Implementation note |
|---|---|
| Shared ticker and time | Set `autoRaf: false`; connect `lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)`; add **one** GSAP ticker callback that calls `lenis.raf(time * 1000)`—GSAP supplies seconds, Lenis expects milliseconds. Lenis’s example also sets `gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)`. Do not run a second RAF loop. [web:13][web:19] |
| React 19 / StrictMode cleanup | Create ScrollTriggers in `useGSAP()` from `@gsap/react` so they revert on teardown. For the Lenis integration, remove the *same* ticker callback on effect cleanup and destroy the Lenis instance; this prevents duplicate loops across development remounts. [web:2][web:19][web:13] |
| Reduced motion | Keep Lenis’s default `respectReducedMotion: true`: smoothing stops and programmatic scrolls become instant. Separately, use GSAP `matchMedia()` to omit or simplify motion-heavy animations when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` matches. [web:13][web:45] |
| Native touch | Leave `syncTouch: false` for native-feeling touch scrolling; it is the default. Enable it only if its scroll-sync behavior is needed, noting Lenis’s warning about iOS versions below 16. [web:13] |
| Anchors | Set `anchors: true` for clicked in-page links; Lenis says anchors otherwise do not work while its scrolling is active. For programmatic navigation, use its documented `scrollTo(target, options)` method. [web:13] |
| Pin limits | ScrollTrigger permits **one pinned element per trigger**, not nested pinning. Animate children rather than the pinned element; check spacing in flex layouts and avoid transformed or `will-change: transform` ancestors that disrupt fixed pinning. [web:11] |
| Font-ready measurements | After the display font finishes loading, call `ScrollTrigger.refresh()` to recalculate positions; do likewise after other layout-changing content loads. In a React effect, guard that asynchronous refresh against unmount. Create pinned triggers in page order where possible. [web:56][web:12][web:11] |
| Editorial serif | **Roboto Serif**, under the SIL Open Font License, has a genuine `wdth` axis of **50–150**, plus `opsz` **8–144**. Start around `wdth` **60–75** for tall, narrow display headings and use strong foreground/background contrast; assess the result at actual heading size. [web:90][web:89] |
| Bodoni Moda comparison | Bodoni Moda is also OFL-licensed, but its listed variable axes are only `opsz` and `wght`. It cannot deliver a genuine adjustable width through a `wdth` setting. [web:58] |
